title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 2.13
exact_target: Determine which kinds of exceptional finite values are excluded by large gaps in an entire function's Taylor series, and whether summable reciprocal exponents give stronger conclusions.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2302013 (AMR-022-2013). CC BY 4.0.
